scope: Read-only frozen publication-copy, public-receipt, selected-claim and relative-link audit; no project import, raw source, source-reader invocation, package rerun or remote request.
limitations: Reads retained CI observations; does not independently query GitHub.
Does not rerun retained package, readers, scientific experiments, or exhaustive semantic validators.
Only explicit Markdown links are relocation targets; historical JSON/command/source provenance paths are retained as provenance.
Claim checks are scoped to actual gate results and documentary boundaries, not a proof of every sentence in historical copied evidence.
